ai_review.summary: Fair audience recording of an average show with a nice Bob‑led Me & My Uncle highlight.
ai_review.review: The reviewer finds the performance only middling, noting it isn’t one of the band’s greatest shows or recordings, but appreciates a few bright spots—especially Bob Weir’s turn on “Me & My Uncle.” The source appears to be an audience tape of unknown quality, offering no standout audio fidelity.

ai_rating.rationale: Only one moderate‑rating review; both show and recording are described as average with a few positives.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewer calls the recording "not the greatest" but provides no specific details on clarity or mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: No detailed comments on set structure; overall impression is that the show is unremarkable aside from a few nice moments.

band_member_comments.Bob: Nice moments highlighted, particularly on "Me & My Uncle".
